about_the_game:
Gimlé Trials is a high-energy multiplayer arena game where precision spellcasting meets dynamic strategy. Engage in rapid, skill-based battles where abilities can knock opponents into danger—or save you from the brink of defeat. The rules are simple: stay in the safe zone, outplay your rivals, and become the last one standing.

Key Features:

  • Fast-Paced, Skill-Based Combat: Easy to learn but hard to master, Gimlé Trials rewards sharp reflexes and tactical outplays. Timing, aim, and positioning are your keys to survival.

  • Dynamic Knockback Mechanics: Manipulate the battlefield with unique knockback spells that send foes into deadly hazards like lava, creating exciting, high-stakes moments.

  • Customizable Loadouts: Between rounds, adapt your strategy by drafting new abilities. Craft your arsenal and find creative ways to dominate your opponents.

  • Evolving Arenas: The encroaching lava mechanic turns each match into a thrilling showdown, forcing players into intense close-quarters combat.

  • Strategic Round Progression: Earn currency, draft new abilities, and build your strategy between rounds for an ever-changing battle experience.

Whether you're a competitive player seeking mastery or a casual gamer looking for quick fun, Gimlé Trials delivers chaos, creativity, and excitement in every match. Step into the arena and prove your skill!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher (64 bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2070 / AMD Radeon 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: The arena awaits! Gimlé Trials is a game where skilled warriors clash in chaotic arenas. Outmaneuver rivals, unleash powerful knockback spells, and adapt your strategy as the battlefield shrinks around you. Survive to claim victory in an epic clash of precision, positioning, and creativity.
